notes.claim: A sine wave can be thought of as the vertical displacement of a vector rotating at a constant speed, like the second hand of a clock, whose length is the wave's height or amplitude.
Frequency indicates how many cycles exist in one second.
A sinusoidal quantity can be written A(t) = A max sin(ωt) = A max sin(2πft).
Because the variation is sinusoidal in time, the vertical component of the rotating arrow (its magnitude times the sine of its angle with the x axis) gives v(t).
UK low-voltage supply is declared at 50 hertz unless otherwise agreed in writing.
